plan.name: 2-Week Cycle-Aware Strength Starter
plan.description: A 2-week introductory strength reconditioning plan phased around menstrual cycle: low-intensity, no heavy Valsalva, no high-intensity or jumping during flow days (cycle days 1-3). Starts 2026-06-01.

goals.name: Recondition for progressive strength
goals.description: Build baseline strength and movement quality with cycle-aware intensity modulation.

actions.note: During flow days 1-3, restrict intensity: replace high-intensity cardio with light walk/breathing, replace heavy lifts with lighter loads, remove jumps.

phases.name: Introductory 2-week reconditioning
phases.description: Two-week starter focused on movement quality, submaximal strength, and cycle-aware intensity modulation.

activities.name: Reverse lunge to RDL (bodyweight or light DB)

checkpoints.name: End of week 1 check-in
questions: How was perceived pain during flow days?

checkpoints.name: End of week 2 assessment
questions: Any menstrual symptom changes to note?
